summary: Solid PowerShell implementation with proper `Set-StrictMode`/error handling, pinned action refs, and good module structure. Main concern: version parsing is fragile—regex strip (LicenseChecker.psm1:44) doesn't validate output; silently returns empty string if input is just `^`. requirements.txt regex (line 54) only matches `name==version`, silently skips extras/markers. PowerShell install in workflow (line 15-18) redundant on ubuntu-latest. Otherwise clean design with good test isolation and error codes.
